announcement.quote: On December 1, 2013, Broadleaf Capital Partners, Inc. acquired Sustained Release, Inc. by exchanging with Sustained Release, Inc. shareholders one share of Broadleaf Capital Partners, Inc. Class A Preferred Share for each share they held of Sustained Release, Inc. common stock.

deals.notes: The only share-exchange acquisition in the window that fits a merger-like deal. The 2014-04-04 8-K has a section headed 'Sustained Release, Inc. Rescission' (an 'SRI Rescission Agreement'), saying the Series A Preferred Stock 'were never issued', but the excerpt starts mid-sentence and does not state the rescission terms, so outcome left null. Neither party's listing status is stated. Not a fund merger; other 8-Ks are asset purchases, a spin-off proposal and officer changes.

problems: No closed-end fund merger described. DEFM14A excerpt is an annual meeting proxy (directors, preferred shares). Company later renamed EnergyTEK Corp.
